A POINT OF VIEW

Four things we
will not sell you.

  1. Guest post networks and paid links.

    We favour editorial relevance and earned coverage over manipulative link schemes.

  2. Publishing volume for its own sake.

    Useful coverage and genuine demand should guide the brief, not an article quota.

  3. AI optimisation theatre.

    Schema and llms.txt are not a guarantee of AI citations. We make the limits clear.

  4. Rank reports as the deliverable.

    Positions need context. The useful conversation is about relevant traffic and meaningful conversions.
